thread:
ReleaseCoordinator: heads-up: production rollout for inference-service v2.1.3 starts 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC (in ~45m). Please confirm kill-switch runbook is reachable and pin/unpin commands tested. Link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/deploy-kill-switch

DeployBot: deploy scheduled for 22:00-22:30 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 10m steps. To abort use `deploy-bot abort <deploy-id>` or set canary=0. Will post deploy-id when snapshotting images.

Andy: I validated pin/unpin in staging this morning. Example commands:
```
/deploy pin service=inference model=v2.1.3
/deploy unpin service=inference model=v2.1.2
```
Unpin propagation to edge takes ~30s. Tested rollback latency and token-throughput checks pass.

Priya: @Andy thanks. For canary timing, can we keep first canary at 10m with health checks: error rate < 0.5% and CPU < 70%?

Sofia: +1. Also propose safety fallback to model=v2.1.2-quant if p95 latency > 800ms or error spikes. See runbook section 2.1 for threshold matrix: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/deploy-kill-switch#fallback

Andy: Confirmed. Kill-switch triggers:
- errors > 1% for 5m -> abort
- p95 latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive windows -> unpin to v2.1.2-quant
Escalation: page #eng-oncall -> if no ack in 2m, page release lead and infra oncall.

InfraShiftBot: monitoring hooks validated. Pager path set to #eng-oncall and oncall email. Synthetic check runs every 30s; will mute non-critical alerts during canary.

Dave: I'll be watching traces and traffic-split dashboards at T-0. I'll keep a terminal open to run unpin if needed.

Emily: Quick note: the change window includes feature-flag migration that is backward compatible. If we need to roll forward, we can flip flags instead of full deploy. (reaction :thumbsup:)

ReleaseCoordinator: excellent. Final checklist before we go: confirm runbook link saved, pin/unpin commands tested (done), canary thresholds agreed (done), oncall aware (done). I'll paste the deploy-id once DeployBot snapshots. If anything spikes, call abort and follow runbook. :rocket:
